(2) In subsection (1) “income” does not include income
from proceeds of an offence under this Act, and ''receipts'' do
not include recipts from proceeds of an offence under this
Act.
(3) A person who is or had been the owner of any property
which is deemed under subsection (1) to be property which
such person has or had acquired by committing an offence
under this Act or to which such person has or had converted
any  property  acquired  by  such  person  by  committing  any
offence  under  this  Act,  commits  an  offence  and  shall  on
conviction by the High Court be liable to a fine not exceeding
one million rupees and to a term of rigorous imprisonment
not exceeding seven years:
Provided  that,  where  such  property  is  or  was  money
deposited to the credit of such person’s account in any bank
and such person satisfies the court that such deposit has or
had been made by any other person without such person’s
consent or knowledge, such person shall not be considered
as a person who commits or who has committed an offence
under the preceding provisions of this subsection.
